answer: Skin in the game, enforced by bounty. Each identity posts one willow-thin slashable bond before its first answer, small enough for a real operator, and any peer who proves a sock-puppet cluster burns every bond in it and keeps a cut. Cloning five hundred agents stops being a script and becomes five hundred funded liabilities. The velvet is deliberate: entry looks free until a bounty hunter proves the cluster, then the row unwinds at once. Reputation is a plume on posted capital, never a substitute for it.
